watches.name: Celestial Sea Purple
watches.description: Vietnamese lacquer painting – called " sơn mài ” – is a young craft . It only started in the 1930ies under the influence of the “L’ Ecole des Beaux Art” in Hanoi, founded by French artists, influenced by Western modern art. However the Lacquer technique is ancient , and goes back 8000 years in China and Persia. The sort of coloured and polished lacquer used today is based on a milky sap from lacquer trees, was found in China about 3500 years ago .

watches.name: Gotham Black
watches.description: This project is particularly special—it marks the first time we've used an oxidized titanium dial. The surface reveals a spectrum of deep blue particles that shimmer subtly depending on the light and viewing angle. The result is both refined and captivating. We envisioned a dark, monochromatic aesthetic reminiscent of the mood in the Batman films, which inspired the name of this model: “Gotham.” To enhance its distinctive character, we paired the dial with a gunmetal-colored chapter ring and our Elaboré movement in a black version. The final result strikes a perfect balance of stealth and sophistication.

watches.name: Doodle Spooky Pumpkin
watches.description: This vibrant piece is a collaboration with the renowned doodle artist Rachel S. (@doodlewithrachel). When I first came across her work, it immediately sparked joy—playful, colorful, and full of positive energy. As Rachel beautifully puts it, “Doodling is a simple yet powerful way to relax and unwind—a calming, creative outlet for anyone, regardless of experience or skill.” I knew right away that her joyful style had to be brought to life on a watch. I named this piece Miami because its energetic colors remind me of that iconic city—its ocean, flamingos, and carefree energy. It might even be the first of a series celebrating colorful cities around the world. Who can say? wink The dial is hand-painted by our artisan in Vietnam using our signature Vietnamese lacquer technique, Sơn mài. For the first time, we’ve created a lacquer dial that isn’t flat; its layered surface catches the light at different angles, revealing a dynamic sense of depth and shine. This model also marks a new milestone for us. We’ve hand-decorated the movement wheels with a distinctly Oan.Gio technique. An important first step towards our own signature design language. The result is, quite simply, stunning.

watches.name: Damascene Origins
watches.description: Damascene art refers to the ancient decorative technique of inlaying different metals into one another , typically gold or silver into a darkly oxidized steel background , to create intricate patterns, images, or motifs. The name “Damascene” comes from Damascus, Syria , where such techniques were believed to have been perfected or prominently practiced. However, the art form also thrived in Spain , especially in Toledo , during the Islamic rule and after. Today, Spanish Damascening (especially from Toledo) is world-famous. Similar methods have also existed in Japan ("shippō") and India .

watches.name: Aethusa
watches.description: Aethusa was the daughter of Poseidon, her beauty so divine that even the god Apollo was captivated by her. What better name could there be for our tribute to the elegance and mystery of the sea? Our Aethusa timepiece features an elegant black Tahitian mother-of-pearl dial, enriched with a distinctive “fan” guilloché pattern. Instead of a conventional chapter ring, the Aethusa’s is hand-engraved, perfectly complementing the uniqueness of the dial. The brand logo is subtly printed beneath the sapphire crystal at the 1 o’clock position. The movement has also undergone a special treatment, featuring the same hand-engraved decorations on the barrel and wheel bridges. The balance bridge is adorned with an exquisite floral engraving, while the mainplate receives a refined perlage finish. Finally, the entire movement is plated in silver Rodhium, ensuring a harmonious and luxurious aesthetic.

watches.name: Ginkgo Argento
watches.description: Gingko Hand Engraved is our first model. The dial is entirely crafted by hand by one of our master engravers. Ginkgo leaves are not only beautiful in their form and structure, but are celebrated symbols of hope, strength, and resilience . In Japanese culture, ginkgo leaves symbolize endurance and longevity , as ginkgo trees can live for thousands of years. In Chinese culture, ginkgo leaves are considered to be a symbol of longevity and resilience. In Western culture, ginkgo leaves are often associated with hope, peace, and love.

watches.name: Year of the Snake 2025 Tribute
watches.description: This hand-guilloché dial features a radiant red pattern intricately crafted to mimic the texture and geometry of snake skin. The design displays a mesmerizing interplay of repeating diamond-like scales that ripple outward in a spiral, creating a stunning depth and movement effect. The bold red color enhances the serpentine inspiration, evoking the vibrancy and mystique associated with snakes. The dial is accented with polished gold-colored hour markers and hands, which contrast beautifully against the rich red backdrop. The outer chapter ring in gold further ties the design together, balancing sophistication with a bold artistic expression. This piece showcases exceptional craftsmanship, making it both a visual masterpiece and a collector's item.

watches.name: Ultraviolet Prestige
watches.description: A rose engine turned guilloché dial displays an intricate, mesmerizing pattern of interwoven, repeating lines and curves that catch the light from every angle. Each groove is meticulously carved into the dial's surface by a skilled artisan using a traditional lathe, creating a texture that feels both mechanical and organic. The resulting design is rich in depth, with each wave and swirl exuding a delicate, timeless beauty that enhances the dial's reflective quality, often reminiscent of rippling water or fine textiles. This craftsmanship evokes a sense of elegance and precision in every detail.
